shortBulletSummary: US June CPI data came in lower than expected, reducing concerns about immediate Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and acting as a major catalyst for the crypto market rally.
Bitcoin broke above $65,000 on July 15, following sustained institutional interest, evidenced by $181 million in daily net inflows and $1.2 billion in spot Bitcoin ETF inflows last week.
Japan's parliament approved legislation reclassifying Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies as financial assets, potentially paving the way for crypto ETFs and future tax rate reductions.
EthSystems, a spinout from the Ethereum Foundation, launched a privacy infrastructure designed for institutional Ethereum adoption.
Despite recent price gains, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains in "extreme fear" territory at 25, up slightly from 22.
